F1 wrongly called all elements of kG a basis; replaced kG by G. Checked H-linearity, tensor balancing, G-equivariance, both coset inverse identities, naturality and transported adjunctions. These use the actual group basis and finite transversals and are valid over every field; the Statement is unchanged.

The published CRT supplies coordinate idempotents in R/∏I_j and representatives in R, not idempotents in R. Corrected F4 accordingly. Step 2.1 already uses k[X]/(f_r), and step 4.1 uses congruence representatives whose evaluations are proved idempotent. Checked the integral annihilator, central content separation, local-center primitivity, exact functor projectors and the coset duality pairing; the Definition is unchanged.

The addable-node comparison was quantified beyond the restricted domain: for p=2 adding (1,2) to (1) gives (2). Limited step 3.1 to a restricted deletion pair and step 4.1 to the actual cogood addition, whose restrictedness is already proved in step 3.3. Checked adjacent equal-residue corner obstructions, boundary sign flip, stack inverse and rank changes. The Definition and claimed operators are unchanged.

The omitted intermediate interfaces are actually proved in the cited root-interval carrier: Proof 11.1 gives (P), 16.1 gives (M), 17.1–20.1 gives (Z), 23.1–32.1 proves linked hats and distinct essential pivots, and 39.1–43.1 proves the essential-regular/normal characterization. Read these complete arguments and checked their characteristic-p and arbitrary-dominant-weight hypotheses at endpoint steps 4–9. The endpoint proof then lifts surviving restricted socle factors through the actual corner, localizes by class sums, and transfers to induction by the explicit projected Frobenius adjunction. F2 does not require these results to be repeated in the supplier Statement. No item edit.

Read that complete finite-cell proof and checked endpoint necessity against Brundan Theorem 5.3, including its complete coefficient-functional argument. The test is available locally although absent from the abbreviated Statement. Checked matching sufficiency, restricted socle survival, corner lift, q-content separation, projected Frobenius Hom tests and finite-matrix square-root descent. No item edit.
